sentences.en: Counselling or arbitration is often the best way to solve disputes among members of the public.
sentences.zh: 解决公众成员之间的纠纷时，辅导或仲裁往往是最好的方式。

sentences.en: Tom and Mary decided to go to marriage counselling.
sentences.zh: 汤姆和玛丽决定去接受婚姻辅导。

sentences.en: Sarah found that counselling helped her deal with stress better.
sentences.zh: 莎拉发现辅导帮助她更好地应对压力。
